issue.body: ### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug? core ### Is this a regression? No ### Description When navigating between pages comp1 and comp2 in my demo application by clicking comp1 and comp2 links multiple times, I've observed a concerning trend: the number of DOM nodes increases steadily, eventually leading to a significant slowdown and ultimately crashing the browser tab. Upon inspecting memory snapshots, I've identified a issue: even though my components and directives are being destroyed, they remains in memory. This issue seems to be associated with the Injector, as evidenced by its presence in the constructor `(constructor(injector: Injector).` This isn't an isolated incident; a larger application I've worked on faces similar challenges with Injectors, resulting in browser tab crashes after prolonged use. Addressing this issue is crucial for optimizing performance and stability across my applications. ### Please provide a link to a minimal reproduction of the bug https://github.com/vinayaren31/injector-memory-leak ### Please provide the exception or error you saw ```true No error logged in console. Browser tab crashes after prolonged use of the application. ``` ### Please provide the environment you discovered this bug in (run `ng version`) ```true _ _ ____ _ ___ / \ _ __ __ _ _ _| | __ _ _ __ / ___| | |_ _| / △ \ | '_ \ / _` | | | | |/ _` | '__| | | | | | | / ___ \| | | | (_| | |_| | | (_| | | | |___| |___ | | /_/ \_\_| |_|\__, |\__,_|_|\__,_|_| \____|_____|___| |___/ Angular CLI: 17.1.2 Node: 18.17.0 Package Manager: npm 9.6.7 OS: darwin arm64 Angular: 17.1.2 ... animations, cli, common, compiler, compiler-cli, core, forms ... platform-browser, platform-browser-dynamic, router Package Version --------------------------------------------------------- @angular-devkit/architect 0.1701.2 @angular-devkit/build-angular 17.1.2 @angular-devkit/core 17.1.2 @angular-devkit/schematics 17.1.2 @schematics/angular 17.1.2 rxjs 7.8.1 typescript 5.3.3 zone.js 0.14.3 ``` ### Anything else? _No response_
